result.title: Hyperbolic Graph Representation Learning: Embed in One Metric, Optimize with Another
result.summary: Hierarchical graphs embed in hyperbolic space with lower distortion than in Euclidean space owing to its negative curvature. However, their gradient-based learning is hampered at large radii, where the Poincaré ball and the Lorentz hyperboloid models fail numerically. Polar coordinates avoid this problem, but the hyperbolic metric scales the angular step by the hyperbolic sine of the radius, freezing angular motion. We observe that this factor is a choice, silently fixed by existing implementations: the Euclidean tangent parametrization, for instance, uses the radius itself. We show that other choices are not only possible but preferable. They are endpoints of a one-parameter family of optimization preconditioners with curvatures from $-1$ to $0$, while the embedding remains at curvature $-1$. We show that since the Euclidean preconditioner rearranges a layout but refines it poorly, while an intermediate one refines far better once a layout is in place, combining them in two stages reduces the loss on real-world trees by 46-74% over the best single curvature.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究双曲空间中的层次图表示学习，指出 Poincaré 球与 Lorentz 模型在大半径处数值失效、极坐标角度更新被 sinh 因子冻结，并把这一缩放因子视为可选择的预条件器族（曲率从 -1 到 0），提出两阶段组合优化以降低真实树上的损失。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「度量化选择与优化预条件解耦、半径相关的角度步长缩放」可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的表示几何与更新动力学提供概念类比，可供核查；但不涉及多模态推理或视觉证据，属较远领域。
